Piirros harjarobotista sivulta, ei mitta: Drawing of the bristle robot from the side, not to scale. On the table is a toothbrush head with slanting bristles: the tips of the bristles are further back than their roots. On the back of the brush, at the front, that is on the right, is a vibration motor with a half-disc-shaped off-centre weight on the end of its shaft. Behind the motor is the coin cell with its plus side up. One of the motor's leads runs under the cell and the other onto its top. An arrow pointing right shows the direction of motion.
